description: This file defines an interface called ISyncCallback used as a callback mechanism for synchronization events in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes a method onFinish() and a default method onScheduled().

classes.name: ISyncCallback
classes.description: Interface for sync callback events, providing methods to handle completion and scheduling events.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Method called upon completion of a sync operation.

methods.name: onScheduled
methods.description: Default method invoked when a sync is scheduled, has an empty default implementation.
